scope: Strict TypeScript provider attempt measurements and closed diagnostic projections, plus pure response-synthesis message building and normalization; transport/routes unchanged
limits: No intentional runtime behavior changes in this extraction.
Provider diagnostic projections preserve existing allowlists and upstream/OpenRouter/uncertain provenance rules; requested routes or generic headers do not establish upstream attribution.
UTF-8 request/message/schema component bytes overlap and are not token estimates, real latency comparisons or cost claims.
Measurements retain JSON.parse failure behavior and are not a general strict request-schema validator.
Synthesis builder consumes host-verified facts but does not certify effects or receipts itself; it projects areas/excluded clauses rather than action results.
Normalization retains before-or-after input fallback, before-only output, whitespace collapse and legacy 160 UTF-16-unit slicing; it does not redesign multilingual persona or truncation.
client.js transport, credentials, trace IO/entrypoint, route profiles, retries and request-payload.js remain unchanged runtime boundaries requiring later migration.
Read-only provenance does not evaluate provider SDKs or broaden executable baseline imports.
Node 22 smoke uses one synthetic fetch response in a network-disabled container; no live provider latency/quality/cost measurement or full server boot.
No scheduler, SQL/storage/provider configuration/model choice/deployment/V2 activation or live WhatsApp effect changed; no new PostgreSQL fixture required.
